title: PHP: Arrays and Loops
description: Write a PHP program demonstrating indexed arrays, associative arrays, and loop constructs.

codeTemplate.php:
<?php
// Indexed array
$fruits = ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry', 'date'];
echo "Fruits: " . implode(', ', $fruits) . "\n";
echo "Count: " . count($fruits) . "\n";

// Associative array
$person = [
    'name' => 'Alice',
    'age' => 30,
    'city' => 'New York'
];
echo "Name: {$person['name']}\n";
echo "Age: {$person['age']}\n";

// For loop
echo "For: ";
for ($i = 1; $i <= 5; $i++) {
    echo $i . " ";
}
echo "\n";

// Foreach
echo "\nFruits list:\n";
foreach ($fruits as $i => $fruit) {
    echo "  " . ($i + 1) . ". $fruit\n";
}

// Array functions
$numbers = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2, 6];
sort($numbers);
echo "Sorted: " . implode(', ', $numbers) . "\n";
echo "Sum: " . array_sum($numbers) . "\n";
?>

verificationTest: output.includes('Fruits: apple, banana, cherry, date') && output.includes('Count: 4') && output.includes('Name: Alice') && output.includes('Sum: 31')
hints: PHP arrays can be indexed (0-based) or associative (key-value)
Use `foreach` to iterate over array elements
`implode()` joins array elements into a string with a separator
`array_sum()` calculates the sum of array values
